**Stable ID:** `DATA-08.04` · **Record type:** Work Package · **Workstream:** 08 Evaluation integrity and comparability

Define how human-evaluation protocols and statistical uncertainty are recorded alongside any reported result.

- Human-evaluation protocol fields
- Uncertainty reporting requirements
